note: What a server sends to set what sits in one of a unit's item slots. It answers no request: a client clears the slot named and puts what follows in its place whether or not anything asked for it, so a server sends it to units nobody is buying for.

fields.name: item
fields.note: Which item, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: inSlot
fields.note: How many of it are in that slot now.

bits.name: tellTheClient
bits.note: Set where the client is to show the change. Clear in everything observed.
